BKA MED
Industry Leaders and Their Focus
Mindray:
Patient monitors, diagnostic ultrasound, and life support systems.
United Imaging:
High-end medical imaging like PET/CT, MRI, and advanced X-ray scanners.
MicroPort:
Cardiovascular stents, pacemakers, and orthopedic surgical implants.
Lepu Medical:
Cardiac pacemakers, vascular intervention devices, and diagnostic testing.
Shinva Medical:
Medical sterilizers, digital X-rays, and surgical operating tables.
Edan Instruments:
Patient monitors, ECG diagnostic machines, and point-of-care testing.
Wego Group:
Single-use medical consumables, orthopedic materials, and infusion pumps.
Neusoft Medical:
CT scanners, MRI systems, and digital ultrasound equipment.
Yuwell Medical:
Home-use healthcare devices like blood pressure monitors, oxygen concentrators, and wheelchairs.
Snibe (Shenzhen New Industries Biomedical Engineering):
Chemiluminescence immunoassay diagnostic analyzers and laboratory reagents.
